SELECT p, service_name, metric, round(avg(value),2) avgv, round(max(value),2) maxv, count(*) n FROM (SELECT 'abn' p, * FROM abnormal_metrics_sum UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', * FROM normal_metrics_sum) WHERE service_name IN ('ts-consign-price-service','ts-consign-service') AND metric LIKE '%otlp%' OR (service_name='ts-consign-price-service' AND metric LIKE 'processed%') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3,1
